name: Account Request Failed
description: Sent to a requester to confirm that their account delete request has been failed.
subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request failed for $data.accountName
body:
Account Request Failed

Hello $data.requesterName,

The account $data.operationType.toLowerCase() request for $data.accountName on the $data.sourceName source could not be completed.

Error details

The request failed because of the following error: $data.failureReason

Please contact your administrator for assistance.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
